items.source: Throw a new MutuallyExclusiveConfigurationPropertiesException if multiple values are defined in a set of entries that match the given predicate.
items.translation: 如果一组匹配给定谓词的条目中定义了多个值，则抛出新的MutuallyExclusiveConfigurationPropertiesException。

items.source: Throw a new MutuallyExclusiveConfigurationPropertiesException if multiple non-null values are defined in a set of entries.
items.translation: 如果在一组条目中定义了多个非空值，则抛出新的MutuallyExclusiveConfigurationPropertiesException。

items.source: entries - a consumer used to populate the entries to check
items.translation: entries - 用于填充待检查条目的消费者。

items.source:
Creates a new instance for mutually exclusive configuration properties when two or
more of those properties have been configured.
items.translation: 当两个或更多互斥配置属性已进行配置时，创建一个新的实例。

items.source: Return the names of the properties that have been configured.
items.translation: 返回已配置的属性名称。

items.source: Return the names of the properties that are mutually exclusive.
configuredNames - the names of the properties that have been configured
mutuallyExclusiveNames - the names of the properties that are mutually exclusive
predicate - the predicate used to check for matching values
items.translation: predicate - 用于检查匹配值的谓词

items.source: the names of the configured properties
the names of the mutually exclusive properties

Exception thrown when more than one mutually exclusive configuration property has been
configured.
items.translation: 当配置了多个互斥的配置属性时抛出异常。
